info.title: aztree
info.description: See where your Azure money goes, as a treemap in one offline HTML page.

options.name: --help
options.description: show this help message and exit

options.name: --version
options.description: show program's version number and exit

options.name: --demo
options.description: use fake data (no Azure access needed)

options.name: --subscription
options.description:
subscription to read, repeat for more (default: the
Azure CLI's current one)

options.name: --all
options.description: read every enabled subscription you can see

options.name: --scope
options.description:
any Cost Management scope, e.g. a billing account (not
tested yet)

options.name: --days
options.description:
period to show, compared with the period before it
(default 30)

options.name: --metric
options.description:
AmortizedCost spreads reservation and savings plan
purchases over their term

options.name: --tag
options.description:
tag for the tag view (default: the tag on the most
resources)

options.name: --no-graph
options.description: skip the Resource Graph checks for idle resources

options.name: --from
options.description:
reopen saved data without calling Azure (default: the
last run)

options.name: --export
options.description:
write a summary JSON for an AI agent (default
~/.aztree/aztree-export.json) instead of the page

options.name: --verbose
options.description: print pages, rows and query units per request
